hooks.command: python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath') or d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); print(f.strip())" | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ruff format --quiet "$f" && ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

cd backend && python -m pytest --tb=short -q > /tmp/pytest_out.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /tmp/pytest_out.txt | python -c "import sys; lines=sys.stdin.readlines(); [print(l,end='') for l in lines[-5:]]"; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Tests are failing. Fix them before finishing."}'; fi
